name: Xenia Canary
description:
Xenia Canary is an experimental, open-source research emulator for the Microsoft Xbox 360 video game console. It focuses on pushing the boundaries of Xbox 360 emulation compatibility and performance.

Features:
- Modern graphics emulation utilizing high-performance Vulkan rendering backends
- Resolution scaling up to 4K and support for high-framerate patches
- Emulation of Xbox 360 PowerPC CPU and custom ATI Xenos graphics architecture
- Full support for modern gamepads with analog triggers and rumble vibration
- Active development branch featuring cutting-edge bug fixes and game compatibility updates
